# Generated artist image fixtures

These six JPEGs are original deterministic geometric drawings generated by
`generate.py` (Python and Pillow), with no downloaded photographs, cover art,
fonts, or other third-party artwork. They depict no real artist. Their legacy
filenames only match the catalogue's existing test identifiers.

The three artist image regression suites explicitly set `artistData.artworkRoot`
to this directory. This preserves catalogue photo counts, image loading,
fallback, readiness gating, rotation and synchronization assertions while making
them independent of unavailable reference photographs. The deliberately missing
`missing-photo-for-test.jpg` must remain absent. Other catalogue cover thumbnails
are outside this fixture's scope and may warn about missing files.

These fixtures qualify rendering behavior, not fidelity of photographic art.
They can also be passed as local artwork to native rich-artist fixture captures.
Regenerate with `python tests/fixtures/vinyl-generated-art/generate.py`.
